name: Oto☆Puri ~Koiseyo! Otome Ouji-sama♪ Dokidoki Wedding Bell~
original_name: オト☆プリ～恋せよ！乙女王子様♪ドキドキウェディングベル～
source: Not very careful with money and used to an extravagant lifestyle, Rui's mother has thrown them into terrible debt. To fix this, she has decided that he will be marrying one of four girls, each from a wealthy influential family. Unfortunately, they are all currently going to a girls' boarding school. Fortunately, Rui has an appearance very much resembling a girl and his mother has already taken the liberty of getting him a uniform. He quickly ends up discovering that the girls he is fated to marry one of are all part of the same group that have been chosen by the school to behave and dress as Princes, idols for the rest of the student body to fawn over. And ends up becoming their maid.
translation: 琉衣的母亲花钱毫无节制，早已习惯奢侈生活，因此让母子二人背上了巨额债务。为了解决问题，她决定让琉衣迎娶4名女孩中的一人，而她们都出身富裕显赫的家族。不幸的是，4人目前都在一所寄宿制女子学校就读。幸运的是，琉衣的外表极像女孩，而且母亲已经擅自替他准备好了制服。他很快发现，自己注定要迎娶的女孩全都属于同一个团体：她们被学校选中，要打扮成“王子”并以王子般的举止行动，成为全校学生追捧的偶像。而琉衣最后成了她们的女仆。
